'''Pokémon''' is the opening theme song for the {{pmin|Italy|Italian-language}} dub of the [[S01|first season]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} as distributed by Mediaset. It was used from [[EP001]] to [[EP057]]. The opening animation mainly consists of clips from various episodes of the season, but also footage from the first English opening, [[Pokémon Theme]].

==Trivia==
* This opening theme, unlike its [[Aim to Be a Pokémon Master|Japanese]] and [[Pokémon Theme|English]] counterparts:
** does not feature {{Gary}}, {{Delia}}, or {{an|Professor Oak}}.
** is not used for the entire [[Kanto]] arc of {{aniseries|OS}}.
* All of the main characters' Pokémon in the [[S01|first season]] are featured in the animation, except {{TP|Ash|for|Kingler}} {{TP|Misty|one|Staryu}} {{TP|Brock|each|Steelix}}.
** [[Ash's Tauros|Ash's 30 Tauros]] are also not shown, but the [[EP035|episode]] they were {{pkmn2|caught}} in was [[Banned episodes|banned]], and they didn't reappear until Ash's return to [[Pallet Town]] in [[EP065]], when the [[S02|second season]] had already begun.
* Even though this song was also used as the ending theme, it stopped just before the "[[4Kids Entertainment|4Kids Productions]]" screen, with the last few seconds from an instrumental version of [[Pokémon Theme]] being played instead up to the final "Pokémon" logo animation.
* This song was included in various compilations dedicated to all the cartoons for which Mediaset owned the distribution rights.

===Errors===
* [[Brock's Crobat|Brock's Zubat]] is shown to be capable of carrying [[Ash's Squirtle]] while flying, despite not having any visible way of doing so.
* In the picture that {{TP|Misty|Psyduck}} takes, [[Raichu]]'s normally white belly is orange.
